design.confirmation: Predeclared confirmation: final two compete against each other and all non-finalists on fresh matched seeds, both seats; report holdout-only estimates.
design.seed_disjointness_note: Confirmation seeds are fresh and strictly disjoint from P1 screening, P1 confirmation, P2 screening, and P2 confirmation seeds.
design.finalist_selection_rule: Predeclared baseline-vs-reviewed-challenger confirmation across 8 fresh seeds.
design.uncertainty_reporting: Report uncertainty by whole-seed cluster; do not treat seat swaps as independent seeds.
design.primary: match win points (win=1/tie=.5/loss=0); official rating uses outcome, not coin margin
design.safety: Record status, exceptions, invalid matches, source/manifest hashes, agent telemetry, callback counts, total durations and max/p95 latency; local GEMINI.md states a strict 100ms callback guideline. No Kaggle uploads or submissions.
